question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**he had been left on**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the past perfect tense, which requires the auxiliary verb "**had**" followed by the past participle of the main verb.
 
• The correct form of the verb "**have**" in the third person singular is "**has**," but the subject of the sentence is "**he**," which is third person singular in the past tense.
 
• "**Been**" is the past participle of "**be**," which is used to form the passive voice.
 
• "**Left on**" is the correct phrasal verb to use in this context, meaning that someone was not turned off or shut down.
 
• The phrase "he had been left on" is in the past perfect tense.
 
• The past perfect tense is used to describe an action that took place before another action in the past. 
 
• Structure: "**Subject + had + been + preposition + object**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
